query.esql:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL amount = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL Group = CASE(deployment_group == "", "Unallocated", deployment_group)
| EVAL Deployment = CASE(deployment_name == "", deployment_id, deployment_name)
| EVAL pair = CONCAT(Deployment, " in ", Group)
| STATS `Billed consumption` = SUM(amount), deps = COUNT_DISTINCT(deployment_id),
        groups = COUNT_DISTINCT(Group), one = MAX(pair)
| EVAL Scope = CASE(deps == 1 AND groups == 1, one,
                    CONCAT(TO_STRING(deps), " deployments, ", TO_STRING(groups), " groups"))
| KEEP `Billed consumption`, Scope

query.esql:
FROM cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| WHERE heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL
| EVAL util_score = (conf_utilization_memory_weight * (heap_used_pct_p95 / 100.0)
                   + conf_utilization_storage_weight * (COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0))
                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight)
| STATS score = AVG(util_score), measured = COUNT_DISTINCT(ts)
| EVAL days = DATE_DIFF("days", TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), TO_DATETIME(?_tend))
| EVAL `Utilization score` = score * 100,
       `Days measured` = CONCAT(TO_STRING(measured), " of ", TO_STRING(days), " days")
| KEEP `Utilization score`, `Days measured`

| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == `composite_key`

query.esql:
FROM cluster_tier_and_datastream_contribution_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN billing_realized_pool_lookup ON ck == `composite_key`
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == `composite_key`
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup ON ck == `composite_key`
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| WHERE heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL
| EVAL util_score = (conf_utilization_memory_weight * (heap_used_pct_p95 / 100.0)
                   + conf_utilization_storage_weight * (COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0))
                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight)
| EVAL share_indexing = CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0,
         tier_and_datastream_sum_indexing_time * 1.0 / deployment_sum_indexing_time, 0.0),
       share_query = CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0,
         tier_and_datastream_sum_query_time * 1.0 / deployment_sum_query_time, 0.0),
       share_storage = CASE(deployment_sum_store_size > 0,
         tier_and_datastream_sum_store_size * 1.0 / deployment_sum_store_size, 0.0)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * util_score
| EVAL indexing = share_indexing * chargeable_pool,
       querying = share_query * chargeable_pool,
       storage = share_storage * chargeable_pool
| EVAL blended = CASE(tier == "hot/content",
         (storage * conf_storage_weight + querying * conf_query_weight
          + indexing * conf_indexing_weight)
           / (conf_storage_weight + conf_query_weight + conf_indexing_weight),
         (storage * conf_storage_weight + querying * conf_query_weight)
           / (conf_storage_weight + conf_query_weight))
| EVAL allocated = blended * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS `Allocated cost` = SUM(allocated) BY datastream
| SORT `Allocated cost` DESC
| LIMIT 15
| RENAME datastream AS `Data stream`

                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight)
| EVAL share_indexing = CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0,
         tier_and_datastream_sum_indexing_time * 1.0 / deployment_sum_indexing_time, 0.0),
       share_query = CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0,
         tier_and_datastream_sum_query_time * 1.0 / deployment_sum_query_time, 0.0),
       share_storage = CASE(deployment_sum_store_size > 0,
         tier_and_datastream_sum_store_size * 1.0 / deployment_sum_store_size, 0.0)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * util_score
| EVAL indexing = share_indexing * chargeable_pool,
       querying = share_query * chargeable_pool,
       storage = share_storage * chargeable_pool
| EVAL blended = CASE(tier == "hot/content",
         (storage * conf_storage_weight + querying * conf_query_weight
          + indexing * conf_indexing_weight)
           / (conf_storage_weight + conf_query_weight + conf_indexing_weight),
         (storage * conf_storage_weight + querying * conf_query_weight)
           / (conf_storage_weight + conf_query_weight))
| EVAL allocated = blended * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS day_cost = SUM(allocated),
        day_store = SUM(tier_and_datastream_sum_store_size),
        day_snapshot = SUM(tier_and_datastream_sum_data_set_store_size) BY ts, tier
| STATS `Allocated cost` = SUM(day_cost), mean_cost = AVG(day_cost),
        mean_tb = AVG(day_store) / 1000000000000.0,
        mean_snapshot_tb = AVG(day_snapshot) / 1000000000000.0 BY tier
| EVAL stored_tb = CASE(tier == "frozen", mean_snapshot_tb, mean_tb)
| EVAL Tier = CASE(tier == "unknown", "Unclassified", tier),
       `Mean daily stored` = stored_tb,
       `Cost per terabyte` = CASE(
         tier == "frozen", "snapshot basis",
         tier == "unknown", "tier not reported",
         tier == "hot/content" AND mean_tb > 0,
           CONCAT(TO_STRING(ROUND(mean_cost / mean_tb, 3)), " EUR per day"),
         "not comparable"),
       Basis = CASE(
         tier == "hot/content", "local store size",
         tier == "frozen", "searchable snapshot, not comparable",
         tier == "unknown", "tier not reported",
         "not comparable")
| SORT `Allocated cost` DESC
| KEEP Tier, `Allocated cost`, `Mean daily stored`, `Cost per terabyte`, Basis
